scope: Surgical correction evidence; not complete WP04, global campaign or release acceptance.

envelope.verification: GitHub compare W...S reports one added request and no other delta; published candidate blobs independently matched local blobs.

configuration.fixture_notes: Real HTTP application, authority, business services, SQLite and domain with synthetic seeded case/choice; no live AI model execution.

deduplication.consulted: Existing branches and latest 100 Actions runs before trigger, plus queued/in_progress runs.

run.artifact_expectation: Bun selection: general Playwright evidence upload was skipped; zero artifacts observed. Hosted job log is the evidence source.

OPS-REV-02 real HTTP pr_rejected reviews and applies exactly 100 to 150 once

prepared Procurement mutation uses current actor and SQLite revision, and retries by receipt
prepared Procurement mutation records a stale source conflict without changing the domain

omni.verdict: not applicable (focused: no declaring test ran)

real_persisted_HTTP: draft: prepare/review/Apply 100 to 150 exactly; author, USD currency, source refs, digest and CAS

po_draft: real preparation refused; review rejects a synthetic persisted legacy entry; Apply with an unissued digest is denied with prepared-review-required; Procurement material, Saved history, CAS and receipts remain unchanged.
exact no-op: needs-input/requisition-already-matches without a new effect or receipt
digest mismatch and denied/revoked actor rejected
same operation/key replay returns the same receipt with one effect
stale source after review rejected, preserving the newer CAS
clone_only: Canonical po_draft runtime counterexample: real domain save succeeds but ignores requested PR amount on a disposable clone
Mixed intent: one PR field changes exactly while equal fields stay equal
negative_synthetic: Legacy prepared entries and unissued digests are deliberate negative inputs. They do not establish prior command issuance, historical receipt existence or historical recovery.

limits: The case/choice is persisted seeded fixture data with explicitly pending cost coverage; no AI execution, human timing or global analysis journey was proved.
Retry is within the same active composition. No reload/restart, lost-response recovery or UI H05/I-OPS-02 coverage is claimed.
No historical bad applied receipt is retroactively repaired.
Passing this test run is not a typecheck or guards result; those are recorded separately.
